doc.brief: The QTreeWidgetItemIterator class provides a way to iterate over the items in a [QTreeWidget](xref:qt:QTreeWidget) instance.
doc.index_brief: Way to iterate over the items in a QTreeWidget instance

QTreeWidgetItemIterator & operator++().brief: The prefix `++` operator (`++it`) advances the iterator to the next matching item and returns a reference to the resulting iterator.

QTreeWidgetItemIterator & operator+=(int.brief: Makes the iterator go forward by *n* matching items. (If n is negative, the iterator goes backward.)

QTreeWidgetItemIterator & operator--().brief: The prefix `--` operator (`--it`) advances the iterator to the previous matching item and returns a reference to the resulting iterator.

QTreeWidgetItemIterator & operator-=(int.brief: Makes the iterator go backward by *n* matching items. (If n is negative, the iterator goes forward.)

QTreeWidgetItemIterator(QTreeWidget *wid.brief: Constructs an iterator for the given *widget* that uses the specified *flags* to determine which items are found during iteration.

QTreeWidgetItemIterator(QTreeWidgetItem.brief: Constructs an iterator for the given *item* that uses the specified *flags* to determine which items are found during iteration.

const QTreeWidgetItemIterator operator++.brief: The postfix ++ operator (it++) advances the iterator to the next matching item and returns an iterator to the previously current item.

const QTreeWidgetItemIterator operator--.brief: The postfix – operator (it–) makes the preceding matching item current and returns an iterator to the previously current item.
